messages:
maria: Team — kicking off Havenridge private rollout scheduling. Proposed maintenance window: Mon Apr 6 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need ops + CS signoff.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary job queued: start=2026-04-06T02:00:00Z duration=30m job_id=db-1766004321-c1. Image: redwood/runtime:v1.3.4-rc2, model pin: mpt-quant-8bit:v2026-03-15.

ashok: Heads-up — Havenridge has a KMS rotation at 03:00 UTC (10m window). @lisa-cs flagged this earlier. If KMS collides we'll need to shift or request a small customer exception.

lisa-cs: Confirmed, Havenridge CS can move rotation to 03:15 UTC if we really need. They prefer not to, but ok with a 15-minute slip.

kevin: Ops constraints: we want canary at 10% traffic for 30m, then 50% for 30m before full. Monitoring gates: p95 latency, 5xx rate, and token throughput. Rollback triggers (suggested): 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 250ms OR token error rate spike x2.

samir: Also pin runtime config in console: replicaCount=3, batchWindow=8ms, kvCache=enabled. I put release notes here: https://redwood.internal/releases/rv/1234 — includes known quantization tail artifacts and mitigation.

ops-jen: Preflight checklist posted. I'll run `./scripts/healthcheck.sh --target=havenridge --mode=smoke` 30m before cutover. Added a dashboard tile for canary metrics and a slack alert to #eng-oncall.

maria: @deploybot please avoid starting canary earlier than 02:00. If KMS rotates at 03:00 we should keep the 30m canary then hold at 50% until KMS is done.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary start locked to 2026-04-06T02:00:00Z. Hold step after 50% set to manual.

ashok: Can we add a soft-grace period: if small increase in latency (<20% vs baseline) but error rate stable, we keep canary and extend monitoring another 30m instead of immediate rollback? Helps avoid noisy signal.

kevin: Agree on grace for <20% latency bump AND 5xx <0.2%. If either condition fails, rollback. Documenting rollback plan: immediate traffic shift back to pre-rollout model, flush KV cache, and run `scripts/rollback-tenant.sh havenridge`.

lisa-cs: Havenridge wants a readout and release notes for their security team post-rollout. I'll handle that once deploy completes.

ops-jen: Quick config snippet I pushed to infra: `canary: {percent: 10, duration_m: 30} staged: {percent: 50, duration_m: 30}`. I'll also add a probe for token-level correctness.

maria: OK — approvals: @kevin (ops) ✅, @lisa-cs (CS) ✅, @samir (product) ✅. @havenridge-cs can you confirm KMS final time?

havenridge-cs: We confirm we'll shift KMS to 03:15 UTC to avoid collision. Good to go from our side.

maria: Sweet. Final note: pin model + runtime version in release UI and add emergency rollback contact list. I'll trigger the release doc update and mark this window locked. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll be on watch during the window. If anything odd, @ops-jen / @maria — ping me immediately.

maria: Thanks all — leaving this thread open for any last-minute flags.
